description: This file manages configuration and utilities related to test file discovery for various channel plugins, including path normalization, categorization of channels, and dynamic glob pattern generation for inclusion and exclusion of test files based on plugin roots.

methods.name: normalizeRepoPath
methods.description: Normalizes file paths to use forward slashes for consistency.

methods.name: isChannelSurfaceTestFile
methods.description: Determines whether a given file path is a channel surface test file based on predefined prefixes and exclusion set.
